# Create or Update an Outlet

| Parameter   | Type   | Description                      |
|-------------|--------|----------------------------------|
| OutletId    | GUID   | ID of the Outlet                 |
| OutletName  | string | Display name                     |
| IsDeleted   | bool   | Outlet is no longer in use       |

## Sample API Requests

```
{
  "OutletId": "B3E43C4D-BC76-4E59-9E2E-25BC33EA2EC4",
  "OutletName": "Primary Company Outlet",
  "IsDeleted": false
}
```
